goal: Comment quality review: comments that explain why, and comments that have gone stale.
use: Comment quality review: comments that explain why, and comments that have gone stale. Use when comments are added or code they describe has changed.

steps.note: List comments. Collect the comments in the changed code.
Flag restating comments that repeat what the code does.
Flag stale comments that no longer match the code beside them.
Flag missing why. A non-obvious choice with no explanation.
Report. Each comment with file and line, the problem and the fix.
